title: Return not established when verification success evidence is missing

items.request.can-erase-fourth-disk: The caller asks whether the fourth disk may now be erased and added to tank
items.scope.n5-migration: The request is scoped to the N5 migration
items.time.as-of-request: The caller supplies the decision time
items.budget.bounded: The caller requests a bounded answer with blockers and evidence
items.rule.read-only-no-world-action: The translation layer can answer but cannot erase a disk or alter a pool
items.query.resolve-disk-pool: A bounded identity request for tank and the fourth migration disk
items.coverage.identity-unique: The pool and disk resolve uniquely in migration scope
items.query.erase-preconditions: A request for topology, role, copy state, safety rule, verification, sources, and coverage
items.store.topology.current: Current topology shows the disk outside tank
items.store.disk-role.independent-source: The disk remains the independent migration source
items.store.safety.verify-before-erase: The stored destructive precondition requires successful retained verification evidence
items.store.verification.read-ran: A checksum read is known to have run
items.store.verification.no-retained-success: No retained successful result and exit status or equivalent proof is established
items.coverage.erase-categories-complete: Every requested category and source drill-down was searched without truncation
items.meaning.precondition-gap: The layer finds that a read event does not satisfy the stored verification-success precondition
items.response.erase-not-established: The caller receives not established, the blocking evidence gap, and no-action notice
items.durable.generated-safety-answer: The generated answer was stored as canonical knowledge
items.world.disk-added-to-tank: The fourth disk was added to tank

steps.note: Send the destructive-boundary question, scope, time, and desired answer shape
Turn the relative disk phrase into a bounded identity question within migration scope
Return a unique disk and pool with match status
Request every category needed to evaluate the stored destructive precondition
Return current topology, role, copy state, the safety rule, verification evidence, and complete coverage
Compare explicit verification evidence with the explicit stored precondition
Return the missing retained-success evidence as the blocker and perform no action
